thread:
olivia: post-deploy smoke for v2.14.3 kicked off at 04:00 UTC. canaries in us-east1 + eu-central. watching embed-route, kv-prefill, and short-token probes.

deploy-bot: rollout summary: service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:v2.14.3 mode=staggered postdeploy=running. synth tasks queued.

ben: quick alert 1: short-token p95 in eu-central spiked from ~180ms to ~760ms for ~45s, no 5xx but some timeouts in downstream tokenizer pool.

kai: adding host log: `[2026-03-24T04:01:12Z] host=tok-pool-7 threads=75 cpu=88% tokenizer-queue=high`. also small uptick in kv-prefill misses on those hosts.

olivia: pause next wave. we'll keep canary weight. kai, try pinning eu routes to runtime variant v2.14.3-token-fallback if dry-run ok. ben, keep sampling.

synth-agent: probe run eu-central short-token pre/post dry-run: pre p95=760ms post p95=220ms samples=60 errors=0.

kai: dry-run: `rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-central --from v2.14.3 --to v2.14.3-token-fallback --dry-run --reason "postdeploy token queue spike"`

deploy-bot: dry-run OK. applying pin now.

kai: applied: `rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-central --from v2.14.3 --to v2.14.3-token-fallback --reason "postdeploy token queue spike"`

ben: immediate improvement, p95 down to ~230ms, kv-prefill back to baseline. recommend hold for 20m then resume with extra warmup in eu.

olivia: decision: hold rollout for 20m, add release note amendment stating eu pinned to token-fallback due to token queue spike, and create follow-up ticket for tokenizer pool autoscaling.

kai: will open ticket infra#4521 and schedule low-traffic re-roll after warmup validation.

olivia: closing thread. reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:
